# mapbox uninstall

1 command. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox uninstall

Remove the installed `mapbox` binary

Remove the `mapbox` binary this process is running from.

Deletes only the executable. Stored credentials, `auth logout`'s file, and the separately-installed `tilesets` binary are left alone — run `mapbox auth logout` first if you also want the credential store gone.

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Describe what this would delete, then exit without deleting it. |

```sh
mapbox uninstall
```
